_comment: Shipped default MCP server policy for the supply-chain gate. Verdicts: allow | restrict | approve | block. A server not listed in `policies` falls back to `default` (approve = needs an explicit operator decision, surfaced as info). block => critical, restrict => warning, approve => info, allow => no finding. Record your own decisions in $ZOUROBOROS_CONFIG_DIR/skill-security-gate/mcp-policy.json (or pass --policy / SUPPLY_CHAIN_POLICY); `_examples` shows the shape and is not applied.
